evidence_requirement: Each package must be executed once at authoring time and its exit state recorded; a package that has never been run is a plausible digest, not a receipt. Never bundle a credential - inject at runtime and validate presence at start (spec:10580).
inputs: the confirmation records for each claim
question_or_target: Implementation target: for each P0/P1 claim, emit a self-contained replication package - pinned toolchain versions, inputs or their fetch instructions, the exact commands, the expected outputs and their normalizers, and the pass criterion - runnable by one command. The package is the artifact that makes a confirmation auditable after this program ends.
retry_policy: Two strikes then pivot: after the 2nd failure on the same error-fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative implementations before a 3rd attempt (AGENTS.md 4b).
reviewer_requirement: One reviewer who runs three packages chosen at random.
tests_required: Self-test: every generated package must run green at authoring time.
Secret scan: assert no package contains a credential, cookie or token.
Known-broken control: point a package at a mutated tree and confirm it goes red.
Portability: package paths must not embed the author's absolute profile path.
title: Generate a one-command replication package for every P0/P1 claim
